summary: Steel lookout tower, 30 m high, built 2003 per provincial data. It shares its name with the Alberta community of Vega.

events.note: Steel tower, 30 m, per the provincial lookout data

evidence.supports: steel tower, built 2003, 30 m, elevation 713.0 m, active, access mode drive
photograph dated 2003, credited to Tim Klein, Alberta ESRD online collection
evidence.quote: VEGA 2003 - Tim Klein photo, Alberta ESRD online collection

evidence.supports: Vega is an unincorporated community in central Alberta (county not used in story)
evidence.quote: Vega is an unincorporated community in central Alberta within the County of Barrhead No. 11

evidence.supports: steel introduced for lookout towers in the 1920s and gradually replaced wood
evidence.quote: Introduced in the 1920s, steel increasingly replaced wood for tower construction.

evidence.supports: each site staffed by a lookout observer, generally April to October
evidence.quote: Each site is staffed by a lookout observer whose job is to watch for wildfire all day, each day, generally from April to October.

sources.title: Wildfire lookouts: Torrens, Vega and Trout Mountain (FRIAA FireSmart vector data, lookout layer query)

notes_for_editor: The 2003 build year and 30 m steel tower match the brief and the provincial record, and the 2003 photo credit agrees. The Wikipedia entry is for the community, and the link to the lookout is a shared name only, so the story does not place the lookout in a municipality. No fire, staffing or rebuild history was found. The brief's access 'closed' is not supported by any source read (the record gives ACCESS_MODE 'drive'). The brief has no local_unit.
